description: Create a PDF from an HTML string using a headless browser, so layout, CSS (flexbox, grid, print styles), images and web fonts come out as in a browser print. It takes HTML text only: there is no URL input, and JavaScript is switched off, so pages that build themselves with JavaScript render empty. External resources (images, stylesheets, fonts) load only over https from public hosts; anything else is blocked and skipped, and the PDF is still made. Data URIs work and are the safest way to include images. Letter or A4, portrait or landscape, margin in points (default 36), backgrounds printed by default, optional scale. Limits: html 1 MB, document 50 pages and 16 MB, rendering 15 seconds; the hosted server returns at most 4,000,000 bytes inline, and larger results fail with an error. A completed render counts as 5 requests against the quota; the html argument lists the cases that count for less. Resource, image and font details are in the html argument. Returns the PDF inline as an application/pdf resource. pdf_text_to_pdf handles Markdown, text or CSV with no HTML, and pdf_invoice builds an invoice from data.

html.description: The document as HTML text, up to 1 MB of UTF-8. A full document or a fragment. External resources load over https only: at most 50 requests and 40 MB. Frames, iframes, objects, embeds, audio and video are not rendered. Common fonts (Helvetica, Arial, Times, Courier and generic families) render as Liberation faces, metric-compatible with the originals. Images: 16 megapixels at most each (96 in total); PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or SVG (simplified: scripts, style sheets, filters, masks, embedded images and links are removed; inline style colours are kept); AVIF, BMP, ICO, TIFF, animated PNG and colour-bitmap fonts are not supported, and an image in an unsupported format or over a limit fails the request (a missing image, such as a 404 or a tracking pixel, is skipped). Quota: once the renderer is reached a render counts as 5 requests, failures included; a refusal before a browser starts (for example an inline image refused with image_too_large or unsupported_image) counts as 1; input validation errors and a busy or unreachable renderer count nothing.

margin.description: Margin on every side in points, 0-144. Default 36.

print_background.description: Print background colors and images. Default true.

name: pdf_html_to_pdf

blocked_requests.description: External requests the page made that were blocked by the network policy

bytes.description: Size of the produced PDF in bytes

resource_uri.description: pdfops:// uri of the inline application/pdf resource

title: Create a PDF from HTML
